claim.scope_statement:
For the exact Kümmerle–Maly Algorithm 2.1 in arXiv:2306.04961v2, with target orders r=s=1, prescribed identity initial weight and infinite initial smoothing parameters, we construct a rational sensing Gram on R^(4×2) with joint doubled-order RIP constant δ_(2,2)<2/3. The target is the unique one-row rank-one feasible matrix, yet every iterate from the first onward is the same incorrect matrix, with strictly positive smoothing parameters. A companion geometric proposition proves a sharp 1/√2 lower bound for a specified first-step flat-row mechanism under scalar partial-isometry sensing, including arbitrary kernel dimension. This bound does not apply to general sensing metrics; the counterexample uses such a metric.

This is not a full disproof of the open question: sufficiently smaller RIP constants, other related conditions, and global recovery for useful operator classes remain open. No optimal failure threshold, perturbation-stable attraction, or exhaustive literature novelty claim is made. The result goes beyond the existing CS-421-A1 identifiability discussion by proving failure of the exact initialized recurrence despite doubled-order restricted injectivity and target uniqueness.

The submitted claims receive a new correctness check by GPT 6.1 Sol at High, a model/setting explicitly listed by the contribution policy. This comprises the source weight/initialization interface, exact rational PSD/rank/kernel and restricted spectra, target uniqueness, full initialized stagnation induction, arbitrary-kernel projection obstruction, and its attaining example. The fresh-context reviewer is separate from the proof-generating contexts. No human or formal verification is claimed. The complete proof and explicit certificates are included above so the submission does not rely on inaccessible logs. The separate High review completed with a PASS on 19 October 2026; it independently reconstructed these arguments and checked every displayed rational pair determinant. The checking model and setting were verified from its own runtime turn_context metadata, rather than inferred from a gl
obal configuration. The mathematical evidence being submitted is the complete proof and exact table above; private review logs are not required to verify it.
